'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 John Anderson LS Republic At War''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Republic At War / A Precarious Predicament]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
